data.gender_notes: Hoi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the ancient Greek word hoē, meaning 'desired' or 'loved'. In Christianity, the name Hoi is used in reference to the crowd in the New Testament who asked Jesus, 'What must we do to be doing the works of God?'. The name Hoi carries the meaning “Desired, loved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hoi usually hope their child will grow to embody desired, loved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
